rv.q: In her hands, Cyrano becomes a giddy and sensitive celebration of love; a feel-good romp full of deep pleasures that seem to reach beyond the space in which we experience them.

VIRGINIA Gay’s gender-flipped retelling of Edmond Rostand’s Cyrano de Bergerac, an irreverent rom-com, is a hoot if a little rough around the edges. Cyrano (Gay), a queer woman, has a charming way with words. Her friend, Roxanne (an ebullient Jessica Whitehurst) loves poetry and is seduced by clever language.
